html:
If you are considering travel nursing in Canada, choosing the right agency changes everything. 

The right agency can make your transition smooth, profitable, and professionally rewarding. The wrong one can make it stressful and confusing.

In this guide, you will discover some of the best travel nursing agencies in Canada. 

You will also learn how to evaluate them like a professional. 

By the end, you should feel confident choosing an agency that aligns with your goals.

Let’s get started.

Top Travel Nursing Agencies in Canada

Now let’s look at some of the most reputable travel nursing agencies operating in Canada. These organizations are known for reliability, compliance, and national reach.

1. Goodwill Staffing & Recruitment

Goodwill Staffing & Recruitment is the leading healthcare staffing agency in Canada. They have a strong national presence and decades of experience. Their size gives them access to numerous facility partnerships.

If you prefer working with an established organization, Bayshore offers credibility and structure. They provide support across multiple provinces. Their compliance processes are typically well organized.

Because they are large, communication may feel more structured than personal. However, many nurses appreciate the stability and infrastructure they provide.

What Makes Goodwill Staffing Stand Out

Besides that Goodwill Staffing & Recruitment helps you get travel nursing jobs, they also:

  • Strong national presence across multiple Canadian provinces
  • Extensive network of healthcare facility partnerships
  • Access to consistent travel nursing contracts
  • Structured and compliant onboarding process
  • Clear, transparent contract terms
  • Reliable and timely payroll system
  • Experienced recruiters who understand Canadian healthcare regulations
  • Support with provincial licensing requirements
  • Organized compliance and credential verification process
  • Stable infrastructure backed by industry experience

2. Select Medical Connections

Select Medical Connections specializes in rural and remote placements. These contracts often come with higher pay due to demand. If you are adventurous, this agency could open interesting opportunities.

Rural contracts can be intense but rewarding. You may gain broader clinical experience. You may also qualify for higher hourly compensation.

The agency is known for personalized recruiter relationships. That personal touch can matter when working in isolated communities.

3. Greenstaff Medical

Greenstaff Medical operates internationally and maintains a Canadian division. They work with both domestic and internationally educated nurses. This makes them attractive if you are relocating from abroad.

Their international recruitment experience can simplify credential transfer. They understand cross border compliance requirements. This knowledge is valuable if you are new to the Canadian system.

Greenstaff often provides multi province opportunities. That flexibility can help you explore different regions.

4. Solutions Staffing

Solutions Staffing offers temporary and travel nursing contracts across Canada. They work with hospitals and community care facilities. This provides a range of assignment options.

If you want exposure to both urban and rural placements, they may provide flexibility. Their contracts vary in length and setting. That diversity allows you to tailor your experience.

As with any agency, you should compare offers carefully. Ask detailed questions before committing.

5. Staffmax Staffing & Recruiting

Staffmax Staffing & Recruiting is known for its personalized nurse placement services across Canada.

They focus on matching nurses with travel assignments that suit your skills and career goals.
Recruiters here are proactive, communicative, and focused on your success from start to finish.

Staffmax makes sure to guide you clearly on contract details before you commit. Not to mention that there’s hands-on support throughout your assignment.

What Makes a Travel Nursing Agency the Best?

Before looking at specific names, you need to understand what separates average agencies from excellent ones.

Not all agencies operate at the same standard. Some prioritize speed and volume. Others focus on long term nurse relationships.

The best agencies consistently offer transparency, strong pay, reliable communication, and full licensing support. 

They treat you as a professional asset. They do not treat you like a number in a database.

Here’s what truly matters:

Competitive and Transparent Pay

Money is not everything, but it matters. It only makes sense that your employer compensates you well as a travel nurse. I mean, traveling far away from home has to be worth it.

Top agencies clearly outline your hourly rate, overtime rate, holiday pay, and any completion bonuses. 

They explain whether housing is included or if you receive a stipend. 

There should be no confusion about deductions or administrative fees. 

If you feel unclear about your pay structure, that is a red flag.

In Canada, travel nurse pay varies by province and specialty. Rural and remote assignments often pay more.

High demand areas like emergency, ICU, and labor and delivery usually offer better rates. 

A strong agency helps you understand these differences before you sign.

Provincial Licensing Support

Canada regulates nurses at the provincial level. That means you must be licensed in the province where you work. 

This process can feel overwhelming, especially if you are internationally educated.

The best agencies guide you step by step. They help you gather documentation, explain timelines and requirements, and communicate with provincial regulatory bodies when needed.

If you are new to Canada, this support becomes even more important. You want an agency experienced in working with international nurses.

That experience can save you months of frustration.

Housing and Relocation Assistance

Moving for a short term contract is exciting, but it also comes with logistics.

You may not know the area, rental prices, or even which neighborhoods are safe and convenient.

Others reimburse travel costs. The key is clarity and reliability.

Strong agencies either provide housing or offer competitive stipends. Some negotiate short term furnished rentals for you. 

You should never feel stranded in a new city without guidance. 

A quality agency checks in before, during, and after your move.

Ongoing Contract Support

Support should not disappear after you sign. Contracts can change. Work environments can present unexpected challenges.

The best agencies assign you a recruiter who remains available throughout your assignment. They respond quickly to concerns. They help mediate issues with facilities if necessary.

You want someone who answers calls and emails promptly. You want someone who advocates for you when needed. That level of support defines the best agencies.

How You Should Evaluate Travel Nursing Agencies

Even the best agency on paper may not fit your goals. You need to evaluate agencies based on your priorities. This process requires intentional questions.

Start by clarifying your goals. Do you want maximum income, urban convenience? or adventure? Your answer shapes your choice.

Then compare agencies side by side.

Key Questions to Ask

When speaking with recruiters, ask specific and direct questions.

  • What is the exact hourly rate, including overtime.
  • Is housing provided or stipend based.
  • Are travel costs reimbursed?
  • What happens if a contract is cancelled early?
  • How often will you check in during my contract

Clear answers indicate professionalism. Hesitation or vague responses may indicate problems.

Compare Contracts Carefully

Never rush into signing. Read the contract thoroughly. Understand termination clauses and cancellation policies.

Check payment schedules. Confirm whether you are paid weekly or biweekly. Verify how overtime is calculated.

If something feels unclear, ask for clarification in writing. Documentation protects you.

Urban vs Rural Assignments in Canada

Canada offers very different experiences depending on location. Urban centers like Toronto, Vancouver, and Calgary provide access to major hospitals. These facilities often have advanced technology and larger teams.

Urban living may be more expensive. However, you gain exposure to diverse patient populations. You may also have easier access to amenities.

Rural assignments often offer higher pay due to demand. You may work in smaller teams. You may handle broader responsibilities.

If you enjoy independence and adventure, rural placements can be fulfilling. If you prefer structure and specialization, urban roles may fit better.

Challenges You Should Be Prepared For

Travel nursing in Canada is rewarding, but not without challenges. You may experience short orientation periods. You may need to adapt quickly to new systems.

Weather can also be a factor, especially in northern regions. Winters can be intense. Relocation logistics may require planning.

However, strong agencies help you prepare for these realities. Preparation reduces stress and increases success.

Income Expectations in Canada

Travel nurse pay in Canada varies by province and specialty. On average, hourly rates range from moderate to competitive levels. Rural assignments often exceed urban rates.

While US travel nurses may earn higher raw numbers, Canada offers stability and structured healthcare systems. You should evaluate cost of living differences. You should also consider tax implications.

Ultimately, your net income depends on contract structure and housing costs. Transparent agencies help you calculate realistic take home pay.

Final Thoughts

Choosing the best travel nursing agency in Canada requires research and clarity. You deserve transparency, fair pay, and consistent support. Do not settle for vague promises.

Take time to compare agencies carefully. Ask direct questions and request written confirmation. Your career deserves thoughtful decisions.

The right agency will make your Canadian travel nursing journey profitable and professionally enriching. When you choose wisely, you gain not just income, but experience and growth.

FAQs

1. What are the top travel nursing agencies in Canada?

Some of the most talked-about agencies include Goodwill Staffing & Recruitment, Select Medical Connection, Greenstaff Medical, Solutions Staffing, and Staffmax Staffing & Recruitment.

The best one depends on your needs and location. But in Canada, we highly recommend Goodwill Staffing & Recruitment.

2. How do I choose the best travel nursing agency in Canada?

Look at pay, housing support, travel coverage, contract options, and recruiter communication. A good agency should be clear, responsive, and easy to work with.

3. Do travel nursing agencies in Canada provide housing?

Yes. Many of them do. Some offer free housing, while others give a housing allowance instead.

4. What qualifications do I need for travel nursing in Canada?

You usually need an active nursing license, relevant work experience, and basic certifications like BLS. Some roles may ask for more, depending on the specialty.

5. Are travel nursing jobs in Canada mostly in remote areas?

A lot of them are, especially in rural and northern communities. These jobs often pay more because they are harder to fill.

6. Is travel nursing in Canada worth it?

Yes, for many nurses it is. It can offer better pay, flexibility, new experiences, and career growth.
